layers.note: Short sweep straddling a scene cut, never under dialogue.
Low rain bed under a scene, looped if needed, never the feature sound.
Low crowd bed under a scene, looped if needed, never the feature sound.
Low stream bed under a scene, looped if needed, never the feature sound.
Low wind bed under a scene, looped if needed, never the feature sound.
Low room-tone bed under a scene, looped if needed, never the feature sound.
Footstep layer, hung on the action node that walks.
Wooden-door layer, hung on the open/close action node.
Object-handling layer for put down, hand over, pick up actions.
Cloth-rustle layer for wiping or brushing actions.
Water layer for dipping or swaying actions.
Paper layer for turning or unfolding actions.

note: Recipe SFX references are layer CATEGORIES, not concrete audio files: a recipe says 'a whoosh on the cut' or 'a rain bed under the scene', and the concrete licensed file is bound at mix time from the local cache manifests (see hevi/capabilities/cinematic_data/SFX_NOTES.md). That is why validation here checks the category id, and why a recipe can never smuggle in a file path or executable step.
